name: Psalms
overview: The Psalms reveal a profound celebration of God's mighty deliverance and sovereign power, exemplified in the song of Moses after the Red Sea crossing where the LORD is praised as a victorious warrior who triumphs gloriously over His enemies. These songs express deep trust in God's salvation and strength, acknowledging Him as the eternal God worthy of exaltation and worship. Through such historic and didactic songs, Scripture teaches believers to recognize God's providence, righteousness, and protection in times of trial and victory.
